overview: Yurikawa is a small port town of brick arcades and endless rain, built where three ley lines cross beneath the old quarter. Small magics work near crossings; everyone quietly knows and nobody says it aloud.
laws: Ley crossings grant small magics: warmth, mending, luck at cards.
Cold iron dampens the lines within arm's reach.
The tide follows the ley pulse, not the moon.
tone: Cozy melancholy. Rain most evenings, warm lights, unhurried hearts.
hard_facts: The bakery has stood for ninety years.
There is exactly one train per day, at dawn.
